_: The DECLARATION for DDCS Studio's menu-icon colouring. The glyphs are NOT here — they live in web/ui/headerPost.js's HQ_ICONS and are read from it. This file says only which icons get a fill and what colours it uses.

ruling.human: 2026-08-23, decided by circling a rendered comparison
ruling.rule: Only icons that are a simple single-shape CONTAINER get a solid fill. Everything else stays exactly as it ships — pure outline, untouched.
ruling.why: A folder and a cloud are the only true containers in the set. A gear, a wand, a tick, an external-link frame and a trash can have no interior — filling them removes the lines that make them legible.
ruling.⚠: Save, Local, Wizards, Setup sheet and Get for desktop were rendered filled and REJECTED. They are containers on paper but read worse filled. Do not re-add them because the rule seems to permit it — the rule is the list above, not an inference.

fill._: A CHOSEN solid colour. Not an opacity — an opacity composites with whatever sits behind the menu, so the same icon means a different colour on every surface.

rejected._: Built as live renders, looked at, and declined. Do not reintroduce.
rejected.opacity fills: fill-opacity instead of a solid — changes meaning per surface
rejected.computed fills: color-mix from the accent and the panel — derived, not chosen
rejected.hue-shifted palettes: lightening/darkening each accent programmatically to manufacture a 2nd and 3rd colour. This is what read as 'funky' — a shifted hue is a different colour wearing the same name.
rejected.black outline: correct on a light ground, invisible on dark. Four of the five themes are dark; Setup checklist and Clear disappeared entirely.
rejected.wide accent stroke behind the outline: structurally a halo, reads as blur
rejected.redrawn glyphs: a floppy for Save, an open folder for Open, a floppy-with-ellipsis for Save as. All three declined — the shipped drawings were fine.
rejected.a suite-wide fill rule: leaves half the set untreated, which looks worse than either style alone

shared_glyphs._: One glyph per ACT, not per row — the section header already says which thing is being opened.
shared_glyphs.⚠: Save and Save as share one glyph. The LABEL is the differentiator (human, 2026-08-23).

missing._: Rows that render an EMOJI today and have no HQ_ICONS entry. Human ruling: 'if they dont have svg they need one'.
missing.spec: commandDeck.js:17 — inline line-art SVG, 24x24 stroke grid rendered at 16px, currentColor, its own accent colour, drawn in the spirit of the action.
